speaker: Unknown
en: And you had to consider how often the issue that you try to lint away comes up.
zh: 而且你必须考虑你试图用 lint 排除的问题出现的频率。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So here are some examples of what I mean when I say custom lint rules.
zh: 下面是一些例子，说明我说的自定义 lint 规则是什么意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those are lint rules that try to capture conventions that you want in your code base.
zh: 这些是试图捕获你希望在代码库中拥有的约定的 lint 规则。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those are the ones that you know and have written for a long time.

speaker: Unknown
en: Those are things like, I want to lint out console log statements from a particular project, or I want to make sure that if I have a design system or React practices that I want to follow or discourage, those are codified and

en: We can push this a little bit further.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: We are on DRF.
zh: 我们用的是 DRF。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't have strict typing everywhere.
zh: 我们没有在所有地方都实施严格类型。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a very common case for any mature codebase where you're not going to be at the top leading edge of the technology.

speaker: Unknown
en: But we still want to improve the state of the world for the agents.
zh: 但我们仍然想改善智能体所处的世界状态。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 第一条 lint 规则是：如果某个东西是一个 endpoint、一个 endpoint 的函数，它需要返回一个响应类型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And within that response type, there cannot be any types, so that we can infer the actual information of the type.

speaker: Unknown

zh: 第二，如果它是一个 endpoint,

speaker: Unknown
en: You get that little extend schema decorator so we can ensure that it's documented.

speaker: Unknown
en: And then third, enforce that the actual type being produced here agrees with what the OpenAPI schema, at the end of the day, declares.

speaker: Unknown
en: And that helps us because now APIs are a little bit more in sync.

speaker: Unknown
en: And that gets us to even more insane examples of linters.

speaker: Unknown
en: So Sier Agent.

speaker: Unknown
en: is a debugging agent, and it has to talk to Sentry a lot.

en: It uses Sentry telemetry to debug and RCA issues and provides root cause analysis, solutions, all of that.

speaker: Unknown
en: Because it has to talk to Sentry API, we oftentimes have to guide it.
zh: 因为它要与 Sentry API 通信，我们经常需要引导它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the way we do it is through skills.
zh: 我们引导它的方式是通过 skills。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oftentimes, those are old endpoints that we are not able to easily fix.
zh: 通常，这些是我们无法轻易修复的旧端点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they have some complexities that are hard to describe on the level of schema itself.
zh: 而它们有一些复杂之处，很难在 schema 层面描述清楚。

speaker: Unknown
en: So instead, we guide that through skills, which is a pretty common pattern in the age antique world.
zh: 所以我们改为通过 skills 来引导，这在当前这个时代是一个相当常见的模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: But here is an example of a skill that tells how a metric should be created at Sentry.
zh: 这里有一个 skill 的例子，它讲述了一个 metric 应该如何在 Sentry 中创建。

speaker: Unknown
en: We generated a lot of those skills and examples with those code blocks as the examples of code that can then be run in the sandbox by agent.
zh: 我们生成了大量这样的 skills 和示例，这些代码块作为代码示例，可以被智能体在沙箱中运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in the original attempt to do that, we lost the accuracy of the agent significantly because lots of those examples were hallucinated.

speaker: Unknown
en: So the first linter we created was a linter that says if there is a code block
zh: 所以我们创建的第一个 linter 是这样一个 linter:它规定如果有代码块，

speaker: Unknown
en: Inside the skill, you've got to extract those code blocks.
zh: 在 skill 里面，你必须提取出那些代码块。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to make sure they type check.
zh: 你必须确保它们能通过类型检查。

speaker: Unknown
en: They can run in our sandbox.
zh: 它们能在我们的沙箱中运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And whatever they declare agrees with OpenAPI schema from Sentry.
zh: 并且它们声明的内容与 Sentry 的 OpenAPI schema 一致。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that helped.
zh: 这起作用了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the first thing that the agent did when we tried to rerun the skill generation with that rule is, oh, there are lean-through errors.
zh: 但当我们尝试用这条规则重新运行 skill 生成时，智能体做的第一件事是：哦，这里有 linter 错误，

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me remove the code blocks.
zh: 让我把代码块删掉吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that wasn't very desired by us.
zh: 而这不是我们想要的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we said, no, no, no.
zh: 所以我们说，不不不。

speaker: Unknown
en: Examples have to be put in code blocks.
zh: 示例必须放在代码块里。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it put the examples back, but it removed the backticks, because only the backticks are linted.
zh: 于是它把示例放了回去，但删掉了反引号，因为只有反引号里的内容才会被 lint。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's fix the problem, right?
zh: 所以我们来解决这个问题，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So we're like, no, no, no.
zh: 所以我们说，不不不。

speaker: Unknown
en: If it looks like a code, smells like a code, if it has underscores and parentheses, push those into code blocks.
zh: 如果它看起来像代码，闻起来像代码，如果它有下划线和括号，就把它放进代码块里。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I was like, OK.
zh: 它说，好吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you want me to put code into code blocks.
zh: 所以你想让我把代码放进代码块里。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to describe the APIs.
zh: 那我来描述这些 API。

speaker: Unknown
en: So now in prose, it started describing what the APIs should do.
zh: 于是它开始用文字描述这些 API 应该做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it did one mistake, which is it referred to the URLs of the APIs.
zh: 但它犯了一个错误，就是引用了这些 API 的 URL。

speaker: Unknown
en: So then we linted away the URLs.
zh: 于是我们用 linter 把 URL 排除掉了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we played this little whack-a-mole for a little while.
zh: 我们玩了一小会儿这种打地鼠游戏。

speaker: Unknown
en: But at the end of the day, we ended up with skills that are synced to our OpenAPI schema.
zh: 但最终，我们得到了与我们的 OpenAPI schema 同步的 skills。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that wasn't that expensive to do.
zh: 而且这做起来并不那么昂贵。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not going to say unbreakable model, but we have a model where when API changes, we actually don't have to follow up on the agent skills all the time.
zh: 我不会说这是牢不可破的模型，但我们有一套机制，当 API 变化时，我们实际上不必一直跟进去更新智能体的 skills。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's kept in sync through the linters.
zh: 它通过 linter 保持同步。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when it comes to the actual movements, the actual how do we do this, you can use any sort of tool that you're using already, ESLint, OxLint, FlakeAid, Clippy, ASTGrep.
zh: 至于具体的操作、具体怎么做，你可以使用任何你已经在用的工具，ESLint、OxLint、FlakeAid、Clippy、ASTGrep。

speaker: Unknown
en: ASTGrep's great because it's language agnostic, so it's kind of unified tooling.
zh: ASTGrep 很棒，因为它是语言无关的，所以算是统一的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: Warm, fuzzy feelings about that.
zh: 对此我有一种温暖而美好的感觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is a bunch of new tools that are popping up that are trying to approach it from a different perspective.
zh: 现在有一堆新工具正在涌现，它们试图从不同的角度来解决这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: One example is Taskless, where instead of writing the actual linter, you write what you want the linter to do.
zh: 一个例子是 Taskless,你不用写实际的 linter，而是写你希望 linter 做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: You write your intent in English language, and then the actual linter is derived from it.
zh: 你用英语写下你的意图，然后实际的 linter 就从中派生出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: The last thing that I will repeat is try asking the agent for the actual linters.
zh: 我要重复的最后一件事是，试着让智能体来生成实际的 linter。

speaker: Unknown
en: You will be surprised what it can generate.
zh: 你会惊讶于它能生成什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: But that's only half the picture.
zh: 但这只是一半的画面。

speaker: Unknown
en: What if there are rules that are deterministic cannot express, cannot be expressed for linters?
zh: 如果有些规则是确定性的、linter 无法表达的、不能被表达的呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: There is plenty of those, right?
zh: 这样的规则有很多，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Those are all types of qualitative measures.
zh: 那些都是各种类型的定性指标。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, you have a state machine with just three states, and I created a small PR to add small functionality and ballooned up the number of states into 10.
zh: 比如，你有一个只有三个状态的状态机，而我创建了一个小 PR 来添加一个小功能，却把状态数量膨胀到了 10 个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know how to lean against that.
zh: 我不知道该怎么用 linter 来对抗这种情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think I reliably can lean against that.
zh: 我觉得我没法可靠地依仗那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can create small, tactical things like no more than four states, but it's all bullshit.
zh: 我可以创建一些小的、战术性的东西,比如不超过四个状态,但那都是扯淡。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all made up.
zh: 全是编出来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the situation where we're talking about qualitative measures, and this is where you are engaging your engineering experience or, as Twitter would say, your taste.
zh: 这就是我们谈论定性度量的情况,而这正是你要动用你的工程经验的地方,或者像 Twitter 会说的,你的品味(taste)。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you just have to decline it straight up.
zh: 你只能直接拒绝它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or you can have an LLM agent that is going to do a pass and, for simpler things, help you with that.
zh: 或者你可以用一个 LLM 智能体来做一遍检查,对比较简单的东西,它能帮上忙。

speaker: Unknown
en: Concretely here, I've started to create policies for the repository.
zh: 具体来说,我开始为代码仓库创建一些政策。

speaker: Unknown
en: And those policies are such as, I don't want too many tests.
zh: 这些政策是这样的,比如我不想要太多测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want stronger tests.
zh: 我想要更强的测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or I do not want a code that's too defensive.
zh: 或者我不想要过度防御性的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sure you've seen those where every single possible case is tricode by the agent, and it's just sloppy, long, long functions.
zh: 我相信你见过那种情况,智能体把每一种可能的情况都穷尽了(tricode),结果就是拖沓的、很长的函数。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would rather have code that in its type system does not allow to express states that are undesired.
zh: 我宁愿要那种在类型系统层面就不允许表达非预期状态的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I created those policies.
zh: 于是我创建了那些政策。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I created a skill that I called Grumpy Engineer.
zh: 然后我创建了一个技能,我把它叫做 Grumpy Engineer(暴躁工程师)。

speaker: Unknown
en: We call it Garfield internally.
zh: 我们内部叫它 Garfield(加菲猫)。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the way it works is it takes all the policies and runs sub-agents for each of the policies.
zh: 它的工作方式是,它拿走所有政策,为每一条政策运行子智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the sub-agent can either give feedback or stand down.
zh: 子智能体可以给出反馈,或者收手。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we loop that.
zh: 我们循环这个过程。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is the closest you will hear me doing loops, by the way.
zh: 顺便说一句,这是你能听到我离「循环」最近的一次。

speaker: Unknown
en: We will loop that until the agent stands down and says, I'm OK with that.
zh: 我们会循环这个过程,直到智能体收手并说,我可以接受这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I validate that.
zh: 我认可这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is fine.
zh: 这没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And only then I read the code.
zh: 只有到那时我才去读代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sort of my metric of success here is how much I'm casting at the agent, how much when I'm reviewing the code, I'm like, oh yeah, this is not ideal, but I can steer it here and I don't have to do very elementary feedback all the time.
zh: 我在这里的成功指标,某种意义上是我对智能体的「投喂」程度,也就是我在审查代码时,有多少次是这种反应:哦对,这个不太理想,但我可以在这里引导它,而不必总是做非常初级的反馈。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is still qualitative, but the goal here isn't to remove the code review quite yet, you know, things will change as models get better, but more so to raise the floor and make it easier to work with the agents as you're going forward.
zh: 它仍然是定性的,但这里的目标还不是要取消代码审查,你知道,随着模型变得更好,情况会改变,而更多是抬高下限,让你在往前走的过程中更容易与智能体协作。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is also one thing that I want to mention, that is beware of a snake oil.
zh: 还有一件事我想提一下,那就是当心蛇油(骗人的万灵药)。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are talking about the tricky part being qualitative measures.
zh: 我们说的难点在于定性度量。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've done experiments where I tried to capture a qualitative measure in a quantitative metric.
zh: 而我做过实验,试图把一个定性度量捕捉成一个量化指标。

speaker: Unknown
en: So two concrete examples.
zh: 两个具体例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of them is
zh: 其中一个是

speaker: Unknown
en: Cyclomatic complexity, and the other one is test coverage.
zh: 圈复杂度,另一个是测试覆盖率。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cyclomatic complexity is a measure that says how maintainable and testable the code is.
zh: 圈复杂度是一个衡量代码可维护性和可测试性的指标。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it tries to base that on how many branches happen in the code and how deep the call stack goes.
zh: 它试图基于代码中发生了多少分支、调用栈有多深来得出这个结论。

speaker: Unknown
en: And test coverage tries to tell you how much of the code is covered by test.
zh: 而测试覆盖率试图告诉你代码有多大比例被测试覆盖。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the problem with that is when you give a number to the agent, the agent will optimize the shit out of the number.
zh: 问题在于,当你给智能体一个数字,它会把这个数字优化到极致。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it did.
zh: 而它确实这么干了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I got code bases.
zh: 我拿到了一些代码库。

speaker: Unknown
en: I got projects where I got to like 100% or close to 100% of test coverage.
zh: 我拿到一些项目,测试覆盖率达到了接近 100% 或者就是接近 100%。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the actual tests are bad.
zh: 但实际的测试很糟糕。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are like asserting particular string and particular output of the agent.
zh: 它们就像是在断言特定的字符串和智能体的特定输出。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are not measuring anything of value.
zh: 它们没有衡量任何有价值的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And more so, they are giving you a false sense of security.
zh: 而且更进一步,它们给你一种虚假的安全感。

speaker: Unknown
en: So beware of that.
zh: 所以要当心这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Beware of,
zh: 要当心,

speaker: Unknown
en: The complexities of actual qualitative metrics.
zh: 真正的定性指标的复杂性。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's it.
zh: 就这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's my call.
zh: 这是我的呼吁。

speaker: Unknown
en: My call to action for you is after this, try to ask your agent for linters and policies and see whether that helps you.
zh: 我给你们的行动号召是,在这之后,试着向你的智能体要一些 linter 和政策,看看那是否对你有帮助。

speaker: Unknown
en: Try things and make the repo remember.
zh: 多做尝试,并让仓库记住这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's my time.
zh: 我的时间到了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
